name: Dora-Con Cafe
source:
A dragon girl from another world ruled by dragons becomes addicted to a concept café,
This is an everyday love comedy about a con-café where a real dragon girl serves customers.

The cute, comical, wild, heartwarming, and erotic con café life with beautiful dragon girls [Dora Con Cafe] opens today!
